description: Find and compare Japan roadside-station service stops with source evidence and explicit unknowns.

tools.name: bulletins_get
tools.description: Read canonical notice HTML; use notice for bounded text and linked station identity. Required: id.

tools.name: bulletins_list
tools.description: List published notice links; page is zero-based, not a date filter. Optional: page (default: 0).

tools.name: stations_get
tools.description: Inspect canonical station HTML; use station for normalized parking/facility evidence. Required: id.

tools.name: stations_search
tools.description: Search provider HTML; multiple facilities are native OR. Use find for normalized fields and all/any filtering. Required: prefectures (default: all), facilities (default: all), keyword (default: all).

params.name: prefectures
params.description: Provider prefecture IDs joined by + or all

params.name: facilities
params.description: Provider facility IDs joined by + or all (native any-of)

novel_features.name: Stop evidence and unknowns
novel_features.description: Inspect source facts and permission or service unknowns for one station ID

novel_features.name: Ordered station comparison
novel_features.description: Compare up to six ordered station IDs with source facts and per-ID failures

novel_features.name: Scoped straight-line nearby ranking
novel_features.description: Rank source stations by straight-line kilometers from required latitude/longitude, scoped by area and facilities

novel_features.name: Bounded station-linked notices
novel_features.description: Find notices explicitly linked to one station ID within page/detail scan limits

novel_features.name: Offline observation diff
novel_features.description: Compare two saved snapshot files offline by stable station ID and factual fields, or use an explicit synthetic demo
